text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her Debut race right around the 
corner, Tamamo Cross is raring to go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the meal she ate before the race 
was... just a single, astonishingly tiny 
bento box. Will that really be enough to 
sustain her?
